description: CROSS-DISPENSARY identity clusters built from real rows in six store snapshots. Each case is the SAME physical product as listed by different stores, whose naming conventions disagree on everything: brand first vs last vs absent, lineage and THC% inline, shelf codes appended, and three different meanings of the 'other' category. Enrichment must land every member on one identity tuple — this is the products view's 'same product -> same key' contract, and the only test here that measures what a wrong answer actually costs: a split product group. x-ayrloom-honeycrisp-beverage and x-ayrloom-honeycrisp-vape are a matched pair: the same brand and strain in two formats, which must converge WITHIN each cluster without merging ACROSS them. Clusters carry a partial `canonical` where the sources genuinely disagree on the right value (dose vs volume), so they score convergence without asserting a spelling the data does not settle.
